slug.description: URL-friendly slug for the document (used to construct canonical URL)

tags.description: Optional tags for categorization and discovery

blocks.description: Structured content blocks composing the document body

images.description: Blob references for images used within the document content

bodyPlain.description: Plain text representation of the document content for search and preview

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the document was last modified

publication.description: Reference to the parent publication this document belongs to

publishedAt.description: Timestamp when the document was first published

description: A long-form blog document with rich content. Documents belong to a publication (blog) and contain structured content blocks, metadata, and optional media. This is the primary record type for blog posts.
